amountMinVnd.note: Not stated on the official vayonline page. A VPBank blog says a fast loan has a 30 triệu minimum, but that is a marketing article, not a product term.

amountMaxVnd.note: Page: 'Lên đến 200 triệu'. Lower than VPBank blogs (up to 500 triệu; 300 triệu; 1,5 tỷ), so 200 triệu is the conservative value; possibly different packages. See conflicts.

termMinMonths.note: Page: 'Tối thiểu 12 tháng'. Page footnote says rate and term vary by package and VPBank staff set the real offer, so medium.

termMaxMonths.note: Page: 'Tối đa 60 tháng'. Page footnote says rate and term vary by package and VPBank staff set the real offer, so medium.

minPercent.note: Page: 'Lãi suất vay tối thiểu từ 1,2%/tháng tương đương 14.4%/năm'. 14.4 is the bank's own yearly equivalent of 1.2%/tháng (1.2 x 12, nominal). Banner: 'Chỉ từ 1.2%/tháng'. Footnote: rate and term vary by package. A VPBank blog says 'từ 18%/năm' (see conflicts).

maxPercent.note: Page FAQ: 'tối đa 59%/năm tùy từng khoản vay và theo thời gian dư nợ giảm dần'. Figure as stated by VPBank; not independently checked against any legal cap.

basis.note: Page FAQ: 'theo thời gian dư nợ giảm dần' (declining balance).

amortization.note: Page states interest on declining balance but not the repayment schedule. Inferred equal monthly instalments from the worked example (one fixed 9,359,500/month). Not stated.

fees.nameVi: Phí trả nợ trước hạn (thời gian vay thực tế đến 12 tháng)
fees.nameEn: Early repayment fee, actual loan time 12 months or less

timing.note: Charged only when the borrower repays early; how it is paid is not stated, treated as on the event.

mandatory.note: Only arises if the borrower repays early; whether it can be avoided is not stated.

percent.note: Page: '4% nhân số tiền trả nợ trước hạn, tối thiểu 1.000.000 đồng' when actual loan time is 12 months or less. Applies to full or partial early repayment; a year = 365 days. Percent applies to the prepaid amount. Another VPBank domain (uudaicanhan.vpbank.com.vn, unreachable for us) reportedly lists different tiers, unverified (see conflicts).

fixedVnd.note: Not a flat fee; the amount is a percent with a minimum (see minVnd).

mandatory.note: Page lists it under 'Các loại phí có thể phát sinh' and the bank's own worked example includes it, but the page does not say whether it is compulsory or optional. Left unknown, not assumed.

collection.note: Page: VPBank sums the premium over the whole term and collects it all at disbursement ('thu toàn bộ số tiền này tại thời điểm giải ngân'). It does not say whether it is deducted from the payout or added to the loan, and the two change the cost, so left unknown rather than inferred.

method.note: Page: premium 1,3 - 1,8%/năm on declining balance, summed over the term.

ratePercentMin.note: Page: 'từ 1,3%/năm'. Rate varies; the page example uses 1,6%.

insurance.covers: Death or permanent total disability (per page).

minAge.note: VPBank blog (15/01/2025): citizens aged 23 to 60. Not on the vayonline page. Another VPBank blog gives 18-65; the stricter value (23) is stored. See conflicts.

representativeExamples.note: Page: 'khoản vay tiêu dùng VPBank 100.000.000, kỳ hạn vay 12 tháng, lãi suất 20% trên dư nợ giảm dần và 1.6% phí bảo hiểm ... thanh toán hàng tháng là 9,359,500'. Rate period not stated in the sentence (not assumed). Annuity is our inference. Our check: a plain annuity at 20%/yr gives about 9.26M/month, so the gap presumably comes from insurance, but the page does not explain how; consistency left unknown. Total repaid is not published. Source document date unknown (footer 2022).

researchNotes: 1) Licence check: vpbank is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id 'vpbank'). 2) Contradictions are recorded in each product's conflicts[]: max amount 200 triệu (vayonline) vs up to 500 triệu / 300 triệu / 1,5 tỷ (blogs). Rate: vayonline 14.4%-59%/năm reducing vs blog 'từ 18%/năm' and another blog '18-35%/năm'. Early repayment fee: vayonline 4%/3% (min 1.000.000/600.000) vs reported tiers 1%..free on another VPBank domain we could not open. Age 23-60 vs 18-65. 3) Gaps: no consumer-loan biểu phí PDF found (only SME and card-installment ones); no application or disbursement fee stated anywhere (absence is not proof of zero); no official công khai lãi suất cho vay page located; online loan terms and conditions not read (general credit conditions PDF exists at vpbank.com.vn/-/media/vpbank-latest/tai-lieu-bieu-mau/bieu-mau/khcn/dieu-kien-giao-dich-chung-ve-cap-tin-dung-danh-cho-khach-hang-ca-nhan-tai-vpbank-07112022.pdf, not read). The vayonline page is JavaScript-rendered; a WebFetch on 2026-11-02 returned only the title, so figures are from the 2026-11-01 read. 4) Credit-card installment not recorded as a product: search summaries of VPBank pages mention 0% programs with 2-3% conversion fee, installments from 1-1,5%/tháng, 3-36 months, min 3 triệu, early repayment 3%/2% (2022 PDF); some pages are old; the AIA 0% promo expired 30/06/2026. Not verified at source. 5) Surprising: banner says no income proof but FAQ asks for payslips; insurance premium is collected in full at disbursement (deducted vs financed not stated); lead-capture flow only, staff set the real offer; page footer is from 2022.
